frank.docs: I opened a small docs PR to clarify rate limits vs quotas and added a JS + Python snippet for reading rate info from the SDK. Can someone sanity-check wording and numbers?

izzy.sre: Quick scan: mention that the client exposes meta.rateLimit (JS) / resp.meta.rate_limit (Python) and prefer that over raw header parsing. Also add a line about Retry-After semantics.

frank.docs: Yup, included both. Current JS snippet (draft): ```js
const { result, meta } = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-mini', input: '...' });
const rl = meta?.rateLimit || {};
if (rl.remaining && rl.remaining < 5) {
  // jittered backoff based on resetSeconds
  await sleep(Math.random() * (rl.resetSeconds || 1) * 1000 + 50);
}
```

sue.sdk: Slight tweak: comment that burst_used may be present and that resetSeconds can be 0 for some endpoints. Also recommend checking meta.retryAfter when present.

paul.billing: FYI pricing update: Tier C per-token price changed to $0.00030 last month. Also we now show committed vs burst columns in the CSV export. Make sure docs show both.

frank.docs: Updated pricing table and CSV header example to include committed_tokens, burst_tokens, total_tokens, cost_usd. Added a worked example cost calc.

izzy.sre: For the analytics SQL snippet, prefer this small query to avoid double-counting across aliases: ```sql
SELECT date_trunc('day', event_time) AS day, customer_id, coalesce(model_alias, model_id) AS model_name,
       sum(committed_tokens) AS committed, sum(burst_tokens) AS burst, sum(committed_tokens+burst_tokens) AS total
FROM redwood_usage.token_events
WHERE event_time >= now() - interval '14 days' AND event_type = 'generation'
GROUP BY day, customer_id, model_name
ORDER BY day DESC;
```

frank.docs: Good, I'll swap that in and add a footnote: "burst_tokens only present on successful events; failed requests may lack burst data."

ci-bot: build/ci - docs-pr-900 lint OK; linkcheck found /old/billing/tiers -> use /console/billing/usage/tiering.

frank.docs: Fixed link and pushed.

paul.billing: One more tiny language ask: clarify that burst capacity may be configured as free bursts or billed bursts depending on contract.

sue.sdk: Also add a one-line migration note: "If your integration parsed X-RW-RATELIMIT-* headers, migrate to client.meta.rateLimit / resp.meta_rate_limit; example mapping included."

frank.docs: Done. Thanks all. Will merge after CI green.

frank.docs: Merged. Thanks! :tada!
